title: [Feature Request]: Support text and query instructions in OllamaEmbedding
body:
### Feature Description

It seems that `OllamaEmbedding` does not support custom query and text instructions. In contrast, `HuggingFaceEmbedding` provides `text_instruction` and `query_instruction` parameters, which are prepended to the payload. Could the same functionality be added to `OllamaEmbedding`? Or is there currently a way to configure it?

### Reason

_No response_

### Value of Feature

_No response_
